criteriaNotes.0_hash_check: pixel_sha256 of /tmp/fsrooms/gate-r38/star_seal.png computed with src/harnesses/_core/object_gate.pixel_sha256 = e0b1674cae3e18c8a16ae025a874558ee8ccb654565d9eebf081101afc0c6875 (32x32 RGBA, 19 colours, opaque frame x1-30 y2-30).
criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: Flat floor piece seen straight from above: square frame, no side face, no perspective skew; lid bevel lit on N/W inner rim (G column x5, row y6) and frame highlight row y3 / shade row y29 match the top-down floor lighting. Consistent with floor.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Frame uses a warm grey stone ramp (A 58,53,48 outline / L / C / B) with sparse speckle like v5 stone; lid uses a cool 4-step dark ramp (E/N/J/G) with low-contrast texture, gold star ramp M/P and purple Q/O/S/R core. Dark outline + 3-4 step shading matches v5; no flat fills, speckle is low contrast and not noisy at 1x.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: In mock-archive at 1x it reads as a dark sealed stone hatch with a gold-purple star between the two seal steles. The north hinge knuckles (light grey at x6-9 / x21-24, y4-5) and the pull ring (x13-18, y22-26) are small but visible and push it from 'plaque/rug' toward 'lid that opens'. Readability as a trapdoor is adequate, not strong.
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Frame is a flush inlay: full dark outline, no drop shadow, no raised side; sits on the wood floor in the mock without floating. The 2-row top / 1-row bottom transparent margin is not noticeable at 1x and matches the open-stair swap state.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: Clean square silhouette, closed outline, no jaggies. Minor nits (not blocking): the two lower corner seams (black E runs y21 x6-9 and x22-25) stop 2px short of the star legs and read slightly as stubs/slots; isolated lighter G specks beside the hinge straps (x7 y7, x7 y10, x20 y8-9, x19 y10) are faint noise; star is centred on x15 while runes/hinges mirror about x15.5 (half-pixel, inherent to the 32px cell).

items.name: 별 봉인 돌뚜껑(닫힘, 2×2) (star seal)
reasons: Correct flat top-down floor inlay; frame and lid lighting consistent with the v5 floor.
Palette ramps, dark outline and shading steps fit v5 stone; no flat fills or harsh noise.
At 1x in the archive mock it reads as a sealed stone hatch with a star keyhole; hinges and pull ring are visible enough to suggest an opening lid.
Grounded flush with the floor; margin matches the open-stair swap state.

Optional polish (non-blocking): extend the y21 corner seams to meet the star legs or shorten them to 2px so they do not end in empty lid; remove the stray G specks at (7,7),(7,10),(20,8),(20,9),(19,10) or turn them into N.
